title: Disclose test-run history omissions and show continuation guidance only when available
outcome: The Test Runs panel truthfully discloses available versus omitted/compacted detail and does not imply that an exhausted current page cursor is complete retained history.
acceptance: The panel displays accurate existing history disclosure or equivalent truthful retention wording, including the case with omitted identities and no next cursor.
Load older guidance is conditional on an available continuation; project switches and failed reads do not display stale disclosure.
